senses.gloss: पल् {c1c} P. (पलति) To go, move.

पलः [पल्-अच्] Straw, husk
--लं
1 Flesh, meat.
--2 A particular
weight equal to four karshas.
--3 A
particular measure of fluids.
--4
A particular measure of time.
--Comp.
--अग्निः bile.
--अंगः a
tortoise.
--अदः, --अशनः a demon,
Rākṣasa.
--क्षारः blood.
--गंडः a
plasterer, mason.
--प्रियः {1} a demon.
{2} a raven.
--भा the equinoctial
shadow at midday.
पल्लः A large granary.

1 [पाल्-अच्] A protector
guardian, keeper; as in गोपालः,
वृष्णिपालः, &c.
--2 A herdsman; विवादः,
स्वामिपालयोः Ms. 8. 5, 229, 240.
--3 A
king.
--4 A spitting-pot.
--ली A
herdsman's wife.
--Comp.
--घ्नः a
mushroom.
पलंकट a. Timid, bashful.
पलंकरः Bile, gall.

1 A demon, goblin.
--2
Bdellium.
--3 The किंशुक tree.
--षा
A fly.

पलित a. Weighing or containing
so many palas.

पलित a. Grey, hoary,
grey-haired, old, aged; तातस्य मे
पलितमौलिनिरस्तकाशे (शिरसि) Ve. 3. 19.
--तं
1
Grey hair, or the greyness of hair
brought on by old age;
कैकेयीशंकयेवाह पलितच्छद्मना जरा R. 12. 2;
Ms. 6. 2.
--2 Much or ornamented hair.
--3 A tuft of hair (केशपाश).
--4
Mud, mire.
--5 Heat.
--6 Benzoin.

पालित p. p.
1 Protected, guarded,
preserved.
--2 Observed, fulfilled.

पललः A demon, goblin, an evil
spirit.
--लं
1 Flesh.
--2 Mire,
mud.
--3 A sweetmeat made of
ground sesamum and sugar.
--Comp.
--आशयः swelled neck.
--ज्वरः gall,
bile.
--प्रियः {1} a raven. {2} a
demon.

पलालः, --लं Straw, husk;
N. 8. 2.
--Comp.
--दोहदः the mango tree.
पलक्ष a. Ved. White.

पलवः A kind of net or basket
for catching fish.

पल्लवः --वं
1 A sprout, sprig, twig
करपल्लवः; लतेव संनद्धमनोज्ञपल्लवा
R. 3. 7.
--2 A bud, blossom.
--3
Expansion, spreading, dilating.
--4 The red
dye called Alakta, q. v.
--5 Strength,
power.
--6 A blade of grass.
--7 A
bracelet, an armlet.
--8 Love,
amorous sport.
--9 The end of a robe or
garment.
--10 Unsteadiness (चापलं).
--वः A libertine.
--Comp.
--अंकुरः
--आधारः a branch.
--अदः a deer.
--अस्त्रः an epithet of the god of
love.
--आपीडित a. full of or laden
with buds.
--ग्राहिता {1} dealing with
trifles. {2} superficial knowledge.
--ग्राहिन् a. {1} putting forth sprouts.
{2} dealing with trifles. {3}
diffusive or superficial.
--द्रुः the Aśoka
tree.
पलस = पनस q. v.

पलाश a.
1 Green.
--2 Unkind,
cruel.
--शः
1 A demon.
--2 N. of the
Magadha country.
--3 N. of a tree,
Butea Frondosa (also called किंशुक);
नवपलाशपलाशवनं पुरः Śi. 6. 2.
--शं
1 The flower or blossom of this tree;
बालेंदुवक्राण्यविकाशभावाद्बंभुः
पलाशान्यतिलोहितानि Ku. 3. 29.
--2 A leaf or
petal in general;
चलत्पलाशांतरगोचरास्तरोः Śi. 1. 21, 6. 2.
--3 The green
colour.
--शी Lac.

पालाश a. (शी f.) [पलाश-अण्]
1 Belonging to or coming from the
Palāśa tree.
--2 Made of the wood
of the Palāśa tree; Ms. 2. 45.
--3
Green.
--शः The green colour.
--Comp.
--खंडः, --षंडः an epithet
of the Magadha country.

पलांडु m. n. An onion;
Ms. 5. 5; Y. 1. 176.

1 The temples of an
elephant.
--2 A halter, rope.

पलाय् {c1c} A.
1 To flee, run away,
retreat, fly away.
--2 To escape.
--3
To die away.

पलायक a.
1 Flying.
--2 A
fugitive.

1 Running away, retreat,
flight, escape; Bg. 18. 43,
R. 19. 31.
--2 A saddle.

पलायित p. p. Fled, retreated, run
away, escaped.

पलायिन् a. Fleeing, running away,
a fugitive.
पलालिः A heap of flesh.

पलालः, --लं Straw, husk;
N. 8. 2.
--Comp.
--दोहदः the mango tree.
पलाशकः The tree Palāśa.
पलाशिन् a. Leafy. --m. A tree.

1 An old, grey-haired
woman.
--2 A cow for the first time
with calf (बालगर्भिणी).

1 A glass-vessel, pitcher.
--2 A wall or rampart.
--3 An iron
club; cf. परिघ.
--4 A cow-pen (गोगृह).
--5 The gateway of a building.
पलितंकरण a. Rendering grey.
पलितंभविष्णु a. Becoming grey.
पलितिन् a. Grey-haired.
पल्यं Ved. A sack for corn.
पल्यंकः A bed; see पर्यंक.

1 A saddle.
--2 A rein,
bridle.

पल्लवः --वं
1 A sprout, sprig, twig
करपल्लवः; लतेव संनद्धमनोज्ञपल्लवा
R. 3. 7.
--2 A bud, blossom.
--3
Expansion, spreading, dilating.
--4 The red
dye called Alakta, q. v.
--5 Strength,
power.
--6 A blade of grass.
--7 A
bracelet, an armlet.
--8 Love,
amorous sport.
--9 The end of a robe or
garment.
--10 Unsteadiness (चापलं).
--वः A libertine.
--Comp.
--अंकुरः
--आधारः a branch.
--अदः a deer.
--अस्त्रः an epithet of the god of
love.
--आपीडित a. full of or laden
with buds.
--ग्राहिता {1} dealing with
trifles. {2} superficial knowledge.
--ग्राहिन् a. {1} putting forth sprouts.
{2} dealing with trifles. {3}
diffusive or superficial.
--द्रुः the Aśoka
tree.

1 A libertine.
--2 A
catamite.
--3 The paramour of a harlot.
--4 The Aśoka tree.
--5 A kind of
fish.
--6 A sprout; (n. also).

पल्लवति, पल्लवयति Den. P.
1 To put
forth sprouts, bud.
--2 To expand,
spread, make prolix or diffuse.

पल्लवति, पल्लवयति Den. P.
1 To put
forth sprouts, bud.
--2 To expand,
spread, make prolix or diffuse.

1 A libertine, a gallant.
--2 A catamite.

पल्लवित a.
1 Sprouting, having
young shoots or sprouts.
--2 Spread,
extended; अलं पल्लवितेन ‘enough of
further amplification or
expatiation’.
--3 Dyed red with lac.
--तः
Lac-dye.

पल्लविन् a. (नी f.) Having young
shoots or leaves; Ku. 3. 54. --m.
A tree.

पल्लिः --ल्ली f.
1 A small village.
--2 A hut.
--3 A house, station.
--4
A city or town (at the end of
names of towns); as त्रिशिरपल्ली.
--5 A
house-lizard.
--6 A creeping plant.

पालिः --ली f.
1 The tip of the ear;
श्रवणपालिः Gīt. 3.
--2 The edge,
skirt, margin; Bh. 3. 55.
--3 The
sharp side, edge or point of
anything (अश्रि); Bv. 2. 3.
--4
Boundary, limit.
--5 A line, row;
विपुलपुलकपाली Gīt. 6; Śi. 3. 51.
--6 A
spot, mark.
--7 A causeway, bridge.
--8 The lap or bosom.
--9 An
oblong pond.
--10 Maintenance of a
pupil by his teacher during the
period of his studies.
--11 A louse.
--12 Praise, eulogium.
--13 A
woman with a beard.
--14 The hip.
--15 A measure of capacity (प्रस्थ).
--16 A circumference.
--ली A pot,
boiler.

पल्लिः --ल्ली f.
1 A small village.
--2 A hut.
--3 A house, station.
--4
A city or town (at the end of
names of towns); as त्रिशिरपल्ली.
--5 A
house-lizard.
--6 A creeping plant.

पालिः --ली f.
1 The tip of the ear;
श्रवणपालिः Gīt. 3.
--2 The edge,
skirt, margin; Bh. 3. 55.
--3 The
sharp side, edge or point of
anything (अश्रि); Bv. 2. 3.
--4
Boundary, limit.
--5 A line, row;
विपुलपुलकपाली Gīt. 6; Śi. 3. 51.
--6 A
spot, mark.
--7 A causeway, bridge.
--8 The lap or bosom.
--9 An
oblong pond.
--10 Maintenance of a
pupil by his teacher during the
period of his studies.
--11 A louse.
--12 Praise, eulogium.
--13 A
woman with a beard.
--14 The hip.
--15 A measure of capacity (प्रस्थ).
--16 A circumference.
--ली A pot,
boiler.

1 A small village or
station.
--2 A house-lizard.

1 The tip of the ear.
--2
The sharp edge of a sword or of any
cutting instrument.
--3 A
butterknife.

पल्वलं A small pool or pond,
a puddle, tank (अल्पं सरः); स
पल्वलजलेऽधुना… कथं वर्ततां Bv. 1. 3;
R. 2. 17; 3. 3.
--Comp.
--आवासः a
tortoise.
--पंकः the mud of a pool.

पालकः [पाल्-ण्वुल्]
1 A guardian,
protector.
--2 A prince, king, ruler,
sovereign.
--3 A groom, horse-keeper.
--4 A horse.
--5 The Citraka tree.
--6 A foster-father.
--7 Protection.
--8 One who maintains or observes
(as a promise &c.)

पालन a. [पाल्-भावे ल्यु ल्युट् वा]
Protecting, guarding &c.; Ki. 1. 1.
--नं
1 Protecting, guarding,
nourishing, cherishing, fostering; लब्ध˚
R. 19. 3; so प्रजा˚, क्षिति˚, &c.
--2
Maintaining, observing, keeping
(as a promise, vow &c.)
--3 The
milk of a cow that has recently
calved.

पालनीय a.
1 To be protected or
guarded.
--2 Fit to be protected,
preserved or maintained.
--3 To be
kept or observed (as a promise, vow
&c.)

पालयितृ m. A protector, guardian;
R. 2. 69; 8. 32.

पालकाप्यः N. of a sage, son of
Kareṇu (who first taught the science
of elephants).
--प्यं The science of
elephants.

1 The olibanum tree.
--2
A hawk.
--की Incense.
पालक्यः --क्या Incense.
पालक्यः --क्या Incense.

पालल a. (ली f.) Made of the
powdered sesamum-seed.

पालित्यं Greyness of hair
caused by old age, hoariness.
पालिंदः Incense.
पाल्लवा A game with twigs.

पाल्वल a. (ली f.) Coming from
a pool.
